law.catch_line: Powers of Director; regulation and implementation
law.text:
The Director:
In consultation with the State Fire Marshal, may adopt regulations necessary to carry out and administer this chapter;
In consultation with the State Fire Marshal, may adopt regulations for the conduct of random inspections of retailers, vending machine operators, and wholesalers to ensure compliance with this chapter; and
Shall ensure that the implementation and substance of this chapter is in accordance with the implementation and substance of the New York fire safety standards for cigarettes.
